stories.label: Iran-US nuclear talks in Geneva
stories.summary: Iran-US nuclear talks set for Feb 18 in Geneva. India seized three Iran-linked sanctioned tankers. Graham said intervention 'within weeks.' Huckabee doubts compromise. IRGC drills in Hormuz continue.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
stories.summary: Ukraine recaptured 201 sq km in five days — biggest gain since 2023 — going into Tuesday Geneva talks with rare battlefield momentum. Russia possibly weakened by troop redeployments.

stories.label: Sudan compounding humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: Drone strike on crowded market killed at least 28 civilians. Third consecutive cycle of coverage. AU summit declared world's worst crisis. 11M+ displaced. Covered three cycles now — rest unless new mass-casualty event.

stories.label: European defence autonomy push
stories.summary: Macron visiting India with Rafale jet deal on table — European defence industry expanding beyond NATO partners. Munich Security Conference called for rearmament. EU mutual defence pact advancing.

stories.label: Global AI model race and governance
stories.summary: Pentagon close to cutting ties with Anthropic over military use restrictions — may label it supply chain risk. India AI summit ongoing. Macron bringing AI cooperation to India. Tension between safety commitments and defence demands sharpening.

stories.label: Iran anti-regime protest movement
stories.summary: Massive diaspora rallies Feb 15 followed by anti-regime chants inside Tehran. Not selected this cycle but remains relevant as Geneva talks approach. Watch for Friday protests.

stories.label: Trump Gaza Board of Peace
stories.summary: $5B+ pledged. Inaugural meeting Feb 19. Albania, Romania attending. Indonesia preparing up to 8,000 peacekeeping troops. No new developments this cycle.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire under strain
stories.summary: Israel struck near Lebanon-Syria border killing 4, claiming to target Islamic Jihad. First claimed strike on IJP since Nov 2024 ceasefire. No new developments this cycle.

stories.label: Israel ultra-Orthodox conscription crisis
stories.summary: Hundreds of ultra-Orthodox men chased female IDF soldiers in Bnei Brak, flipped police car. 23 arrested. Not selected this cycle — watch for political fallout or repeat incidents.

stories.label: US military deployment to Nigeria
stories.summary: 100 US military trainers landed at Bauchi Airfield for counter-insurgency partnership. Non-combat role under Nigerian command. Signals US Africa strategy pivot after Sahel withdrawals.

stories.label: Cuba fuel crisis and US blockade
stories.summary: Spain routing humanitarian aid through UN to bypass US fuel blockade on Cuba. European ally openly working around US sanctions policy. Cuba cancelled cigar festival, fuel crisis acute.

stories.label: Pentagon-Anthropic AI ethics clash
stories.summary: Pentagon close to cutting ties with Anthropic, may label it supply chain risk. Frustrated with restrictions on military use of AI. Follows reports of Anthropic AI use in Caracas raid.

stories.label: Pakistan PTI sit-in over Imran Khan
stories.summary: PTI sit-in now in fifth day. KP cut off from rest of country. SC ordered medical exam but PTI rejected it. Not selected this cycle — watch for resolution or crackdown.

stories.label: Myanmar-ASEAN war crimes standoff
stories.summary: East Timor became first ASEAN member to accuse Myanmar of war crimes. Junta expelled East Timor envoy. Not selected — watch for ASEAN response.

stories.label: Scientific brain drain to China
stories.summary: Brain Prize-winning neuroscientist Konnerth moved to Shenzhen Bay Lab. Not selected this cycle — one-off event unless pattern emerges.

stories.label: Nepal post-uprising election
stories.summary: Campaigning underway for March 5 parliamentary election. Not selected this cycle — watch as election approaches.

stories.label: US Venezuela oil blockade enforcement
stories.summary: US forces boarded tanker in Indian Ocean enforcing Trump's Venezuela blockade. Not selected two cycles — fading unless new incident.

stories.label: Navalny death European investigation
stories.summary: Five European countries accused Russia of killing Navalny with dart frog toxin. No new developments — story fading.
